issue: गोविंद: the closing signature; read as the poet's name.
our reading: Govinda is in your refuge night and day
alternatives: the Lord Govinda (Viṣṇu) as the subject

issue: हृदय निवास भक्त बर दीजै: read as one boon, her dwelling in the devotee's heart.
our reading: grant your devotee the boon of your dwelling in his heart
alternatives: two requests: dwell in my heart, and grant your devotee a boon
